name: 902 DXF Prep
description: Batch DXF cleanup & prep for Boost 902 part files. Pop-up process picker (all selected by default) runs any combination of: IGES CONVERT folder + QTY sheet, DXF rename/sort for AutoCAD review, recombine + reconcile against the PO spreadsheet (extras moved to EXTRA, missing parts listed, (Nx) quantity prefixes).
author: Anthony Sieben
